search_text: published ZDI-24-1336 ZDI-CAN-24304 Wacom Center WTabletServicePro Link Following Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability 2024-10-11 CVE-2024-9766 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2024-9766 7.8 AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Wacom'] ['Center'] This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of Wacom Center. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within WTabletServicePro process. By creating a symbolic link, an attacker can abuse the service to create a file. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of SYSTEM. Fixed in version 6.4.7 https://www.wacom.com/en-gb/support/product-support/drivers?driver-search=571 ['2024-05-30 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2024-10-11 - Coordinated public release of advisory', '2024-10-11 - Advisory Updated'] Amol Dosanjh of Trend Micro https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-24-1336/
title: Wacom Center WTabletServicePro Link Following Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of Wacom Center. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within WTabletServicePro process. By creating a symbolic link, an attacker can abuse the service to create a file. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of SYSTEM.
